description: Run a raw SoQL query against any San Francisco open-data resource (data.sfgov.org, also written data.sf.gov) by its Socrata id (8-char like "wg3w-h783" or "ebsh-uavg"). Covers SF city purchasing/procurement records (resource id "ebsh-uavg") — real column names fiscal_year, po_dt, purchase_order, purchase_order_line, purchasing_department, purchasing_department_title, commodity_code, commodity_title (the item name/description column — there is no "commodity_description"), vendor_name, vendor_street, vendor_city, vendor_state, vendor_zip_code, vendor_contact, vendor_email, vendor_phone, encumbered_quantity, encumbered_amount — as well as every other SF Socrata dataset by resource id; if you do not already know a dataset's exact column names, omit `select` (every column comes back) rather than guessing one, since Socrata 400s on an unknown column instead of ignoring it. Full SoQL: where/select/group/order/limit/offset. Use sf_datasets to find a resource id, or sf_recent for the common ones (including "purchasing").

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own Socrata app token for higher rate limits. Omit to use the keyless endpoint.

name: sf_query
title: Sf Query
